topic: Nancy Kanwisher Fusiform Face Area Discovery, Five fMRI Control Tests, Inverted Geometry Drop & Awake Cortical Stimulation Proof
act5_climax_episode: Awake clinical cortical stimulation of the right ventral fusiform patch selectively warping perceived person geometry while adjacent objects and room fixtures stay completely unchanged.
